findings.note: ur.ui.onboarding greeting_done/greeting_owed make the product's chief of staff grammatically feminine ('{name} آپ کی چیف آف اسٹاف ہیں', matching fr cheffe / es jefa); here the possessive is masculine oblique 'آپ کے', so the same persona changes grammatical gender between screens. Grammatical in isolation, hence MINOR, not a meaning defect; 'کا/کے منتظر' still agrees with پیغام/پیغامات.

validation.independence: Auditor (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, session c911849eb597) did not translate these strings; translator session 94dcc5a13838. All claims checked against catalogue bytes read from the worktree; helper scripts ran from the auditor's own scratchpad.
validation.semantics: Both notices say the messages are waiting (منتظر) and that the reader must SEND one message (ایک پیغام بھیجیں) in that conversation to receive them; nothing implies opening is enough, and nothing implies refused/failed/read/lost. Unlinked variant adds 'find that conversation in the sidebar' (سائیڈ بار میں وہ گفتگو تلاش کریں), matching English. hold.open 'چیف آف اسٹاف کو پیغام بھیجیں' renders 'Message' as a verb, imperative-first in Urdu order, as a navigation label. Register: آپ with respectful imperatives (بھیجیں، تلاش کریں) per style guide. Terms: چیف آف اسٹاف equals ui.onboarding greeting_done/greeting_owed; سائیڈ بار equals ui.shell.sidebar_navigation and ui.settings usage; پیغام/پیغامات and گفتگو consistent with the other 84 keys; انہیں spelling matches repo practice (10 vs 0 انھیں). Only drift: masculine possessive vs onboarding's feminine (F1, F2).
validation.icu: Parsed en and ur with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser: both notices are a single plural on `count` with arms one/other, {count} present in every arm; hold.open has no arguments, as in en. Formatted with intl-messageformat (ur) for 0, 1, 2, 5, 21, 1000000: one arm only at 1, other otherwise; outputs read and correct.
validation.plurals: Intl.PluralRules('ur').resolvedOptions().pluralCategories = [one, other], matching glossary and ur style guide. Agreement per arm verified: one 'پیغام … کا منتظر ہے … اسے'; other 'پیغامات … کے منتظر ہیں … انہیں'.
validation.typography: File is NFC; no U+200E/F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9, U+061C, ZW chars or BOM anywhere in the file. Urdu full stop ۔ ends each sentence; no Latin . , ? ; or Hindi danda in the hold values. {count} renders as a Latin-digit run at the logical start (right edge in RTL), per style guide (Latin digits v1); unformatted large counts mirror the English source's plain {count}. Key set and order equal English (87/87); the 84 non-hold values are byte-identical to `git show HEAD:` (base sha256 e9e78fec…ecb4, which equals the inherited receipt's ur sha256 for this namespace); file ends with a trailing newline like base.
